subject: Entropy by quasi harmonic approximations on multiple CPU

messages.author: ABDUL BASIT
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users,
I am trying to calculate the entropy by the quasi-harmonic approximation
method. The calculations are a bit slow, so I was trying to use MPI to
enhance the speed. After using 32 cores I did not find any significant gain
of speed. Whether it uses a single CPU for QH calculations or multiple CPUs
can be used?
Thanks in advance.
Abdul Basit
Research Fellow
School of Computational & Integrative Sciences
Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi-110067
India
